# Round Robin Sports Algo

> Proprietary player prop picks for fantasy and prediction markets (MLB and NFL; NBA from October 20, 2026), built by a data professional
> with 20 years in the fintech data industry after three years of development and testing; picks come from a consensus of models with
> in-season recalibration. Free picks are the
> highest hit-rate calls; every published pick is graded in public at the price posted. Live and backtest results are never mixed.

## What we publish
- MLB Quick Hits: Early, Midday and Night editions posted as each window's lineups lock; a recap grades every call the next morning. https://rrsalgo.com/mlb/
- NFL Quick Hits: one edition per kickoff window (Thursday, Sunday morning/early/late/night, Monday), posted about 75 minutes before kickoff after
  inactives; results the morning after each window; a weekly recap every Tuesday. https://rrsalgo.com/nfl/
- How picks are built and graded: https://rrsalgo.com/about/

## Grading
NFL props settle at Kalshi's official settlement; MLB props at the official box score; spreads and moneylines at the final score.
Records read "X of N" (picks won of picks graded). Value plays, anytime TDs and long shots are judged in units (1 unit risked per pick).
